threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep asking for directions to the train station, but it's 'the Overground' now. Welcome to your new life dodging cyclists and hipster cafes.
Last night on the 59, a guy was singing to a pigeon that had hitched a ride. Pigeon didn't seem impressed, but the rest of us were in stitches.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was home when I spotted the same guy at the Turkish bakery every Sunday, always juggling fresh simit and a toddler, like it's just another day.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain do you see guys watering their plants outside a bar while drinking a beer. It's that blend of chill and quirky that keeps it real.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know you don't take the 49 when the 33 is running late—hop on the 24 instead, it’s way more reliable during rush hour.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo pulling a suitcase on the 49 bus. Only in SF can you look like you're heading to a wedding while commuting at 5 PM.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often miss the 'horari comercial' signs—shops open for a couple of hours in the afternoon, then close for siesta. It's not just a suggestion.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their hesitance to try the local 'bocadillo de calamares' at a bar—most locals dive right in.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say 'the tube' instead of just 'overground' when you're catching a train from Clapton. It's a dead giveaway.
Last night on the 333, I saw a guy trying to sell homemade candles to a woman who just wanted to get home. Classic Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a guy casually walking his pet iguana on a leash by the canal, I knew I was in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can casually hop off a bus mid-route in Kreuzberg and enjoy an impromptu street concert. The spontaneous vibe is a Berlin hallmark!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here if they can name the taco truck with the longest line on a Tuesday. Tourists don’t get the allure.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today where the driver tried to calm a guy yelling about pigeons stealing his snacks. Classic S.F. chaos on a Tuesday.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all we do is party in Gràcia, but half the night is spent listening to our neighbours argue over their pets' names.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newcomer by their bewilderment at the '1.5-hour' wait for tapas on a Saturday night—like they’re waiting for a flight instead of dinner.
